pattern: resolve or skip the reply after editing for a comment
experience: An edit comment asks for a page change. The agent changes the block, then tells the user in the comment thread; the user resolves the comment, never the agent.

body.text: Fix the typo in this paragraph.

prompt:
A comment on the Spaces page "Roadmap" was sent to you.

Fix the typo in this paragraph.

Change the page as the comment asks, using the Spaces tools. Then reply in the comment thread with t2_spaces_comments (action "reply") saying what you changed. Do not resolve the comment; the user does.
